text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy 
grounds... I noticed a small crowd had 
gathered.

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
Alright, for the "Passionate Derby 
Feature: 1-Day Exclusive Coverage"... 
...Filming, start!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaah~~... Exclusive coverage is 
seriously so nerve-wracking, waah...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I gotta do some facial stretches so I 
don't make weird faces! Ah—Ee—Oo—...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're already filming this part 
too!?

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
Just relax! Please just show us your 
burning passion for the Derby in your own 
way, Ticket-san!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-YES SIR! I'LL SHOW YOU FOR REAL!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her nervous attempts to handle the 
interview continued wherever she went 
afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahh! These leg presses really burn up 
the thighs, man!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
I see! So this is where that leg power is 
forged! Is your driving force, as 
expected, your passion for the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Y-YES SIR! IT IS MY PASSION FOR THE 
DERBY!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah! Hamburger steak and omurice! I'm 
gonna chow down big time~~!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Could this menu choice also be 
connected to your passion for the Derby, 
perhaps!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Y-YES SIR! IT MIGHT, POSSIBLY, BE 
CONNECTED...!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's no useee! I'm way too nervous, I 
can't run like I usually dooo!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's wrap up running for now 
and move on to the roundtable discussion.

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
Even so... to think that even after 
experiencing countless races, Ticket-san 
still gets nervous.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... Normally I'm totally fine with 
regular interviews, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whenever it comes to the Derby, I get all 
pumped up... or rather, I tense up and 
brace myself...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's the Derby! Just watching it 
gives you a totally different kind of 
thrill compared to any other race!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text: A different kind of thrill?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The Derby that I've dreamed about 
since I was a little kid. A stage for 
true, serious battles where everyone 
clashes with everything they've got.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about that, like... my heart 
goes *thump-thump-thump*, and then...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everything right in front of me goes 
completely *BOOOOM*! And this overwhelming 
power wells up, like *WRAAAAH*!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
Err... so in other words, the Derby is so 
incredible that your emotions just 
explode? Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! The Derby is just so amazing! 
Just talking about it makes my whole body 
burn up... burn up...

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text: ...? Ticket-san?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWAAAH! I WANNA RUN SO BAAAD! I'M GOING 
FOR A RUN!!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text: Huh, run? ...Right this second!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HERE I GOOOOO~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAH! DEEEERRRRRBYYYYYY~~!!

text_block_list.name: Film Crew
text_block_list.text:
T-Ticket-saaaan! What about the roundtable 
interviewww~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Afterwards, having run to her heart's 
content, she seemed to have successfully 
finished shooting the roundtable 
discussion.
